# Vendored libraries for the planner, the guide and the wrist card

Copied into the repo so the pages work with no internet access (demo rule). Do not edit
these files; to update, replace them from the same npm package and keep the license file.
The 3D map's library (three.js) is in `web/3d/vendor/`, with its own README and license.

| File | Library | Version | License | Copyright | License file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deck.gl-9.1.14.min.js` | [deck.gl](https://deck.gl) (vis.gl) | 9.1.14 | MIT | Vis.gl contributors | `LICENSE.deck.gl.txt` (from the npm package) |
| `qrcode-generator-1.4.4.min.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) | 1.4.4 | MIT | (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase | `LICENSE.qrcode-generator.txt` (from the GitHub repository; the npm package has no license file) |
